Questions

Is there an iPhone app?

An APK file only installs on Android. On iPhone or iPad, open the web app in Safari or Chrome and use Share, then Add to Home Screen. Chrome needs iOS 16.4 or later for this.

Which file types can I import?

APKG from Anki (with images), saved HTML question-bank pages (DAMS files work, images are extracted), Excel (.xlsx), CSV, and JSON backups.

How do I move to a new phone?

Settings, Export full backup, save the .sdpack file. On the new phone go to Settings, Import, and pick it. Decks, scores and test results return exactly as they were.

Can AI change my questions without asking?

No. Corrections apply only when you tap Apply AI Corrections.

What does Reset Progress delete?

You choose: clear scores only, or a full reset that keeps your decks.
